The moon-lit yard is not far from my home. I am happy every day. Lily wants to visit Tokyo. Warm milk with honey helps me sleep.
Lily's favorite subject is history. I like my life very much. David often helps me with history. Best of all, as an only child, he learned to play alone.
We often go to the park together. The moon-lit yard is my favorite place. After school, we play together.
